source_name: OPSI dataset – Zbirka letnih statističnih poročil o oddanih javnih naročilih
why_relevant: Annual government statistical reports on awarded contracts give aggregate market size and category trends, useful for sanity-checking bottom-up vendor totals derived from individual notices.

source_name: Direktorat za javno naročanje (MJU) – sistem javnega naročanja / e-JN
why_relevant: Policy owner of the SI procurement system; publishes guidance, thresholds, statistical reports and the map of which portal carries what. Essential for interpreting notice semantics and procedure types correctly (e.g. 'postopek s pogajanji brez predhodne objave' = single-source award, a strong incumbent signal).

source_name: Smernice za javno naročanje informacijskih rešitev (MJU/GZS)
why_relevant: Official guidelines for procuring IT solutions define the standard vocabulary and lot structures Slovenian public buyers use when tendering banking/core-IT systems — a glossary source that improves keyword recall on the notice portals.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Katalog informacij javnega značaja
why_relevant: The central bank's public-information catalogue states that its procurement documentation is published on enarocanje.si and lists its FOI route. It is the authoritative pointer to central-bank purchases of cash-handling, banknote-processing and banking IT — highest-signal buyer in the cell.

source_name: SID banka – Javna naročila
why_relevant: State-owned development bank publishing its own procurement calls and conditions. As a bank, its IT, payments and card-services purchases map directly to the vendor landscape this cell tracks.

source_name: UJP – Uprava RS za javna plačila (jnplacila.si / ujp.gov.si)
source_subtype: state payments authority / buyer and integration documentation
why_relevant: UJP is the state's public-payments authority and an active buyer of payment services: a confirmed award (JNPP 7/2020, ~EUR 49,198.75 incl. VAT) contracted NLB for card/online-banking payment acceptance in the UJP e-Plačila application. Its documentation names accepted schemes and PSP partners (MasterCard, Visa, Maestro, Diners, Activa, VALÚ Moneta, mBills, Abanet, NLB Klik) — a direct partnership map.

source_name: Državna revizijska komisija (DKOM) – odločitve in iskalnik
why_relevant: Review decisions on challenged procurements are published in full and routinely quote tender requirements, competitor names, bid prices and technical objections that the sanitised award notice omits. Losing bidders' arguments are one of the few windows into competitive positioning and pricing in SI banking/payments tenders.

source_name: OpenTender (Government Transparency Institute) – EU/SI procurement
why_relevant: Third-party normalisation of TED plus national portals across 35 jurisdictions including Slovenia, in OCDS-compatible form. Useful as a cleaned cross-check and for cross-border vendor comparison (does a vendor winning in SI also win in HR/RS/AT?).

source_name: Bankart d.o.o. – pridobiteljstvo / processing services
source_subtype: vendor/processor site used as decoding key
why_relevant: The shared Slovenian card processor sits behind most acquiring and POS/ATM arrangements that public and state-owned buyers contract for. Its service descriptions let award notices that name only a bank be decoded into the actual technical vendor chain (acquirer -> processor -> terminal supplier).

source_name: Pošta Slovenije – POS terminali (state-owned buyer/reseller)
why_relevant: A large state-owned enterprise that both buys and distributes POS acceptance, and is itself a contracting authority under SI procurement rules. Its terminal and payment-partner disclosures identify who supplies the state-owned distribution channel.

source_name: Lawinsider (SL) – razpisna dokumentacija corpus
why_relevant: Third-party corpus that has captured Slovenian 'razpisna dokumentacija' (tender documents) which are often removed from the originating portal after the deadline. Useful for retrieving historic tender specifications when the primary source has rotated them out.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Register of Supervised Entities (EN mirror)
why_relevant: English mirror of the master register; easier normalisation of entity-type labels and useful for cross-referencing SI entities with EBA/ECB EU-level registers.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Register placilnih institucij / Register of payment institutions
why_relevant: Dedicated sub-register of authorised payment institutions (including hybrid PIs), their agents (zastopniki) in SI and host states, and branches. This is the exact list of licensed non-bank payment competitors relevant to a POS/payments vendor.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Placilne storitve in storitve izdajanja elektronskega denarja (licensing gateway)
why_relevant: Describes licence categories, AISP registration procedure and hybrid-PI conditions - the taxonomy needed to classify actors correctly when building the competitor universe.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Katalog zbirk podatkov: Seznam notificiranih placilnih institucij (PDF)
why_relevant: Data-catalogue entry documenting the official dataset 'list of notified payment institutions' - tells you what fields BSI holds and under which legal basis, which is how you request or justify structured extraction.

source_name: EBA central register of payment and electronic money institutions (PSD2 register)
source_subtype: EU supervisory register with downloadable data
why_relevant: EU-wide register mirroring national registers, updated at least daily, with passporting detail per host member state. Filtering to home=SI gives outbound SI firms; filtering host=SI gives every foreign PI/EMI entitled to serve Slovenia - the single most complete inbound-competitor list.

source_name: EBA - Registers and other lists of institutions (hub)
why_relevant: Index of all EBA registers (credit institutions, payment/e-money institutions, crowdfunding, credit servicers). Stable entry point for locating the current data-download URLs, which change between releases.

source_name: EBA Credit Institutions Register (CRD credit institutions, EEA and non-EEA branches)
source_subtype: EU licence register with periodic data file
why_relevant: Authoritative list of authorised credit institutions per country including branches passporting into SI. Defines the bank-side actor universe (the buyer set for a POS/banking vendor) with stable identifiers (LEI, authorisation dates).

source_name: ECB Banking Supervision - List of supervised entities
why_relevant: Monthly SSM list distinguishing significant institutions (ECB-supervised) from less significant ones supervised by Banka Slovenije, with group structures. Tells you which SI banks are decided locally versus at group/parent level - directly relevant to who buys and who signs.

source_name: OPSI - Poslovni register Slovenije open dataset (AJPES)
why_relevant: Machine-readable, free-to-reuse extract of the business register published twice a month (CSV/XML): registration number, full name, address, legal form, registering authority. The cleanest legal way to bulk-build the SI actor table and to resolve names appearing in supervisory registers and media.

source_name: AJPES - Register transakcijskih racunov (RTR) and wsRtrInfoPs web service
source_subtype: statutory account register + subscription web service
why_relevant: Register of all transaction accounts of business entities held at payment service providers in SI, taken over from Banka Slovenije in 2010. Because every account carries its provider's bank code, aggregate RTR data indirectly reveals which PSPs serve which corporate segments - a rare structural view of banking market share by counterparty, and confirmation of which PSPs actually operate accounts in SI.

source_name: AJPES - eObjave v postopkih vpisov v poslovni in sodni register
why_relevant: Official publication stream of registrations and changes (new companies, capital changes, mergers, name/activity changes, liquidations). Acts as an event feed that flags new fintech entrants and restructurings weeks before any press coverage.

source_name: Sodni register RS (court register public books, sodisce.si / AJPES portal)
why_relevant: The legally constitutive register for companies (d.o.o., d.d.): founders, shareholders, representatives, supervisory board members, share capital. This is where ownership and control of Slovenian payment/fintech actors and their partners is established, and it supports connected-person snowballing.

source_name: AJPES JOLP - Javna objava letnih porocil (public annual reports)
why_relevant: Statutory public filing of annual reports and financial statements for all SI companies. Once the licensed-actor list is built from BSI/EBA, JOLP turns each name into revenue, headcount and ownership trend data - the quantitative backbone for competitor sizing.

source_name: ATVP - Registri (Securities Market Agency register index)
why_relevant: Index of ATVP's statutory registers. ATVP is the second Slovenian supervisor of relevance: it licenses investment firms and, under MiCA, crypto-asset service providers - actors that increasingly overlap with payments.

source_name: ATVP - Ponudniki investicijskih storitev (investment service providers: BPD and banks)
why_relevant: Lists brokerage houses (borznoposredniske druzbe) and banks authorised to provide investment services in SI. Together with the BSI register it completes the licensed-financial-actor picture and identifies institutions that buy trading/payment technology.

source_name: ATVP - Register odvisnih borznoposredniskih zastopnikov (tied agents register)
why_relevant: Statutory register (Art. 278 ZTFI-1) of tied agents established in SI and from other EU member states. The agent/intermediary layer is the distribution channel of financial products and mirrors the payment-agent (zastopnik) concept in the BSI register.
